# messy-app design system

messy-app is a React + Tailwind app with 17 color tokens, a 7-step spacing scale (4–32px), 6 shared components and 25 rules. When you build UI here, use an existing component first, then the tokens below; never hardcoded colors or arbitrary spacing like `p-[13px]`. Follow the rules, most important first, and check new text against the approved color pairs.

## Most important rules

- Use `<Button variant="primary">` for the main action on a page and `<Button>` for other actions; never a raw `<button>`.
  - ✓ `<Button variant="primary">Save</Button>`
  - ✗ `<button className="bg-blue-500 text-white px-4 py-2">Save</button>`
- Use `<Button>` instead of `<CTAButton>` or `<PrimaryBtn>`.
  - ✓ `<Button>Save</Button>`
  - ✗ `<CTAButton>Save</CTAButton>`
- Use `<Panel>` instead of `<Card>`.
  - ✓ `<Panel>…</Panel>`
  - ✗ `<Card>…</Card>`
- Only use spacing tokens (4, 8, 10, 12, 16, 24, 32px); no arbitrary values like `p-[2px]`.
  - ✓ `<div className="p-1">`
  - ✗ `<div className="p-[2px]">`

## Accessibility

### Approved text and background pairs

Ratios are WCAG 2 contrast. Normal text needs 4.5:1; large text (24px, or about 19px and bold), icons and form borders need 3:1.

| Background | Text (4.5:1 or more) | Large text, icons and borders only (3:1) |
|---|---|---|
| `blue-500` | gray-900 | gray-50, gray-100, gray-800, red-50, white |
| `blue-600` | gray-50, gray-100, red-50, white | gray-200, gray-300, gray-900 |
| `gray-50` | blue-600, gray-500, gray-700, gray-800, gray-900, red-600 | blue-500 |
| `gray-100` | blue-600, gray-700, gray-800, gray-900 | blue-500, gray-500, red-600 |
| `gray-200` | gray-700, gray-800, gray-900 | blue-600, gray-500, red-600 |
| `gray-300` | gray-700, gray-800, gray-900 | blue-600, gray-500, red-600 |
| `gray-400` | gray-800, gray-900 | gray-700 |
| `gray-500` | gray-50, white | gray-100, gray-200, gray-300, gray-800, gray-900, red-50 |
| `gray-700` | gray-50, gray-100, gray-200, gray-300, red-50, red-300, white | gray-400 |
| `gray-800` | gray-50, gray-100, gray-200, gray-300, gray-400, red-50, red-300, white | blue-500, gray-500, red-600 |
| `gray-900` | blue-500, gray-50, gray-100, gray-200, gray-300, gray-400, red-50, red-300, white | blue-600, gray-500, red-600 |
| `red-50` | blue-600, gray-700, gray-800, gray-900 | blue-500, gray-500, red-600 |
| `red-300` | gray-700, gray-800, gray-900 | none |
| `red-600` | gray-50, white | gray-100, gray-200, gray-300, gray-800, gray-900, red-50 |
| `white` | blue-600, gray-500, gray-700, gray-800, gray-900, red-600 | blue-500 |

### Contrast fixes to follow

- Text on `gray-100` uses `blue-600` or darker (needs 4.5:1).
- Text on `white` uses `blue-600` or darker (needs 4.5:1).
- Icons and form borders on `white` use `gray-500` or darker (needs 3:1).
- Text on `gray-100` uses `gray-700` or darker (needs 4.5:1).
- Text on `gray-50` uses `gray-500` or darker (needs 4.5:1).
- Text on `white` uses `gray-500` or darker (needs 4.5:1).
- Behind `gray-500` text, use a `gray-50` background or lighter (needs 4.5:1).
- Text on `red-50` uses `#da2324` or darker (needs 4.5:1).
- Behind `white` text, use a `blue-600` background or darker (needs 4.5:1).

### Labels, focus and interaction

- Click handlers go on buttons and links, not on divs or spans, so keyboard and screen reader users can reach them.
  - ✓ `<Button onClick={openDetails}>Details</Button>`
  - ✗ `<div onClick={openDetails}>Details</div>`
- Keep a visible focus style. If you remove the outline, add a replacement such as `focus-visible:ring-2`.
  - ✓ `<a className="outline-none focus-visible:ring-2" href="/billing">Billing</a>`
  - ✗ `<a className="outline-none" href="/billing">Billing</a>`
- Icon-only buttons need an aria-label that says what they do.
  - ✓ `<Button aria-label="Close"><XIcon /></Button>`
  - ✗ `<Button><XIcon /></Button>`
- Images need alt text that describes them. Use alt="" for images that are only decoration.
  - ✓ `<img src="/team.jpg" alt="The team at the 2026 offsite" />`
  - ✗ `<img src="/team.jpg" />`
- Every input needs a label. A placeholder isn't a label, because it disappears as soon as someone types.
  - ✓ `<label htmlFor="email">Email</label> <input id="email" type="email" />`
  - ✗ `<input type="email" placeholder="Email" />`
- Text needs at least 4.5:1 contrast with its background; large text (24px, or about 19px and bold), icons and form borders need 3:1. On white, body text uses `gray-500` or darker.
  - ✓ `<p className="text-gray-500 bg-white">Due today</p>`
  - ✗ `<p className="text-gray-300 bg-white">Due today</p>`

These are static checks. They catch some accessibility problems, not all, so passing them doesn't make a screen accessible on its own.

Use the name in Tailwind classes, e.g. `bg-blue-500`.

| `black-40` | #000000 at 40% | 1 | |
| `black-50` | #000000 at 50% | 1 | |
| `blue-500` | #3b82f6 | 12 | Not for text on gray-100 or white. Not behind white text. |

| `gray-300` | #d1d5db | 3 | Not for text on white. |

### Spacing

Use the step in any spacing class (`p-6`, `gap-6`, `mt-6`). Don't use arbitrary values.

| Step | Size |
|---|---|
| `1` | 4px |
| `2` | 8px |
| `2.5` | 10px |
| `3` | 12px |
| `4` | 16px |
| `6` | 24px |
| `8` | 32px |

## Components

Import paths are from the repo root; adjust them to the importing file.

### Button

`import { Button } from "src/components/Button";`

- Props: `children`, `className`, `variant`
- Variants: `ghost`, `primary`, `secondary`
- Use instead of `CTAButton` or `PrimaryBtn`
- Example: `<Button variant="primary">…</Button>`

### Dialog

`import { Dialog } from "src/components/Dialog";`

- Props: `children`, `confirmLabel`, `description`, `onCancel`, `onConfirm`, `open`, `title`
- Example: `<Dialog open={isOpen} title="…">…</Dialog>`

### Modal

`import { Modal } from "src/components/Modal";`

- Props: `children`, `onClose`, `open`, `title`
- Example: `<Modal open={isOpen} title="…">…</Modal>`

### Navbar

`import { Navbar } from "src/components/Navbar";`

- Props: `current`, `onNavigate`
- Example: `<Navbar />`

### Panel

`import { Panel } from "src/components/Panel";`

- Props: `children`, `heading`
- Use instead of `Card`
- Example: `<Panel heading="…">…</Panel>`

### TextField

`import { TextField } from "src/components/TextField";`

- Props: `className`, `hint`, `id`, `label`
- Example: `<TextField label="…" />`
